micselect.title: MicSelect - Global Cross-Border E-Commerce Payment Integration
micselect.subtitle: A next-generation global e-commerce payment system built on Saleor + FilixPay
micselect.background_text: MicSelect is a curated cross-border e-commerce platform featuring quality China-made products, focused on premium supply chains and an international shopping experience. Built on the Saleor open-source e-commerce framework and Next.js, MicSelect is dedicated to delivering quality Chinese-manufactured goods with a seamless online shopping experience for global consumers.
challenges_items: Unified integration of multiple payment channels
Optimizing payment success rates for global users
Insufficient payment extensibility of the e-commerce platform
Webhook and asynchronous payment status synchronization
micselect.solution_intro: FilixPay provided MicSelect with a complete payment infrastructure:
solution_items: Aggregated international payment channels including Stripe and PayPal
results_items: Successfully achieved a global payment closed loop
micselect.cta_desc: Build global payment capabilities like MicSelect. Start integrating with FilixPay today.

scope.label: What you deploy

audience.label: Best for

audience.full_stack: Banks, payment providers, and enterprises requiring full data sovereignty

infrastructure.full_stack: PostgreSQL, Redis, Keycloak, Docker Compose cluster
